label: mid/late original-phase input of c (or r,d,f,3,t,e,a,y)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (97.6% of mass), never at t=0-1 and never during copy outputs; small residual at the <DEL> step. Rate peaks at orig positions 4-6. The input token sets the magnitude: c is by far the strongest (rate 32%, 1/3 of mass, all top examples ~1.0 are c at position 5-6), then r, d, f, 3, t, e, a, y. Stronger when the token is a first occurrence and when earlier inputs include tokens such as 2, 0, n, w, u, g, q, b (first_tok 2/0 has highest lift), suggesting a distributed hidden-state code mixing current token and prefix contents. Weak or absent on inputs like l, i, q, b, h, and on repeated tokens. Predicate captures ~83% of mass on dev but precision ~0.5, so it is a partial description.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=2: c, r, d, f; t=3: c, r, d, f; t=8: c, 3, r, f) and the first original token (most: 2, 0, w, n, u, g; least: t, f, 3, r); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=5, t=6.
